podcast.title: Foundation by Siouxsie and the bandsheets
podcast.body: Siouxsie and the bandsheets are credited as one of the founding groups of modern goth culture. Despite their reported aversion to the label, they are inextricably linked with the scene. "The bandsheets were one of the founders of modern goth culture. And even though they hated that tag, they are inseparable from that scene."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Importance of Clothes and Accessories
podcast.body: For Goth culture, clothing and accessories hold immense importance, serving as fundamental elements that define its distinctive visual identity and aesthetic. "Clothes and accessories are very important to goth culture."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Queen of Goth - Siouxsie Sue
podcast.body: Siouxsie Sue, the singer of Siouxsie and the bandsheets, is widely regarded by many fans as the "queen of Goth." "Susie is still considered to be the queen of Goth by many fans"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
